name: Ultimate Logo Slider & Carousel – Logo Showcase & Gallery
author: aThemeArt

sections.description:
Ultimate Logo Slider & Carousel helps you display logos in attractive, responsive sliders, carousels, grids, and showcase layouts. It is suitable for client logos, customer and partner logos, sponsors, brands, agencies, portfolios, and project showcase sections.

Create multiple independent logo showcases and place them anywhere on your WordPress site using a shortcode, the Gutenberg block, or an Elementor Shortcode widget. Each logo can include an image, title, destination URL, alt text, and description.

The plugin includes responsive device-specific columns, navigation controls, autoplay settings, styling options, lazy loading, RTL support, accessibility-friendly markup, and per-showcase custom CSS. You can also preview a showcase from the WordPress admin before publishing it.

Key Features

  • Logo Slider & Carousel – Display logos in responsive slider and carousel layouts.
  • Client Logo Showcase – Present client, customer, partner, sponsor, and brand logos clearly.
  • Project Showcase – Use logo grids and showcase layouts for project pages, portfolios, agencies, and business websites.
  • Multiple Layouts – Choose carousel, single-item slider, static grid, or showcase layouts.
  • Unlimited Showcases – Create separate logo sections for different pages or website areas.
  • Responsive Columns – Set different column counts for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.
  • Navigation Controls – Use arrows, dots, mouse drag, touch, and swipe navigation.
  • Autoplay Options – Configure slide speed, delay, pause on hover, and looping.
  • Logo Styling – Control logo size, spacing, grayscale, opacity, hover effects, borders, background, and alignment.
  • Image Alt Text – Add custom alt text to logo images to support clearer image content and accessibility.
  • Lazy Loading – Support native image loading and carousel lazy loading options.
  • Accessibility Support – Includes ARIA labels, focus states, and reduced-motion support.
  • RTL Support – Automatically follow the site direction or force RTL/LTR mode.
  • Custom CSS – Add custom CSS scoped to individual showcases.
  • Shortcode Support – Use [logo_slider id="123"] in pages, posts, widgets, and compatible builders.
  • Gutenberg Block – Add the “Logo Slider” block and select a saved showcase.
  • Elementor Compatible – Insert the shortcode using Elementor’s Shortcode widget.
  • Admin Preview – Preview your logo showcase directly from the editor.
  • Lightweight Assets – Front-end carousel assets are packaged locally with the plugin.

Usage

  1. Go to Logo Slider → Add New in the WordPress admin.
  2. Add your logo images from the Media Library.
  3. Enter optional titles, links, alt text, and descriptions for each logo.
  4. Configure the layout, responsive columns, navigation, autoplay, styling, and advanced options.
  5. Publish the showcase.
  6. Copy the generated shortcode or insert the Logo Slider Gutenberg block.

Shortcode

Use the following shortcode and replace 123 with the ID of your showcase:

[logo_slider id="123"]

The legacy [ed-logo] shortcode is also retained for backward compatibility.

Privacy

Ultimate Logo Slider & Carousel stores logo showcase settings and content in your WordPress database. The plugin does not require an external account or a third-party API for its core logo slider and showcase functionality.

The plugin may provide links in the WordPress admin to the aThemeArt website and support resources. These links are user-initiated and are not required for the plugin’s core front-end functionality.

Credits

This plugin includes Owl Carousel 2, distributed under the MIT License. The bundled library is included locally with the plugin.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the logo-slider-showcase folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the plugin from the WordPress admin when it is available in the Plugin Directory.
  2. Activate Ultimate Logo Slider & Carousel from the Plugins screen.
  3. Open Logo Slider in the WordPress admin and create your first showcase.
  4. Add the showcase to a page or post with the shortcode or Gutenberg block.
sections.faq:
Can I display client logos and partner logos on the same page?

Yes. Create separate showcases for different groups, or add multiple logos to a single showcase. You can use the same approach for clients, customers, partners, sponsors, and brands.

Can I create a project showcase with logo links?

Yes. Each logo item can have its own destination URL, making the plugin useful for project showcase pages, agency portfolios, and client sections where visitors need to open a related website or project.

Does the plugin work with the Gutenberg block editor?

Yes. The plugin provides a Logo Slider block. Select a published showcase from the block settings to display it on your page.

Can I use the plugin with Elementor?

Yes. Use Elementor’s Shortcode widget and add a shortcode such as [logo_slider id="123"].

Is the logo slider responsive on mobile devices?

Yes. You can configure separate logo columns for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices. Touch and swipe navigation are also supported for carousel layouts.

Can I customize the appearance of the logo carousel?

Yes. You can control logo size, spacing, alignment, borders, background, grayscale, opacity, hover effects, arrows, dots, autoplay behavior, and other showcase settings. A custom CSS field is also available for individual showcases.

2.0.0

  • Complete rewrite with modern plugin architecture.
  • Added Owl Carousel 2 integration.
  • Added Gutenberg block support.
  • Added carousel, single-item, grid, and showcase layouts.
  • Added responsive device-specific column controls.
  • Added lazy loading, accessibility improvements, RTL support, and custom CSS.
  • Added admin preview and shortcode generation.
  • Retained the [ed-logo] shortcode for backward compatibility.
